## Où j'en suis
SAML SSO for Fernhill works end to end on staging: IdP metadata loaded, real login through Fernhill's ADFS, JIT creates users as `viewer` (PR #415 merged), and the RelayState length fix plus per-tenant group-to-role mapping are in PR #421 (open, not merged). Remaining blocker before the Thursday demo: Fernhill IT must add the `groups` claim to their assertion. (source: ses-sso-3, src-pr415)

- [en-cours] PR #421 "SAML: group to role mapping + short RelayState" (commits 6d0e2b8, f4a91c7) is open and needs review/merge (source: ses-sso-3, pr)
- [en-cours] Fernhill IT to add the `groups` claim on their side; the user is emailing them (source: s3-05, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] once the claim exists, create an admin test account to verify `Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` → `admin` mapping (source: s3-08)
- [prochaine-étape] demo with Fernhill IT, Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 New York, on staging (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] go-live Dec 1 (source: src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] SP-initiated login failed with ADFS error `MSIS7042: RelayState too long` (143-byte return URL vs 80-byte cap); fixed by a short opaque ID stored server-side in Redis (TTL 10 min, deleted on use) (source: s3-02, s3-04)
- [décision] SAML 2.0 only, no OIDC for now; both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows enabled (source: s1-03)
- [décision] default role for JIT-created users is `viewer` (least privilege); Fernhill admins upgrade people (source: s1-05)
- [décision] JIT refuses unverified email domains even if the IdP asserts them; refusal logged without the email (source: s2-03, src-pr415)
- [décision] keep `viewer` as default role and SP-initiated login on, despite the Fernhill IT message asking for `analyst` default and IdP-initiated only; that waits until Maya talks to them (source: s3-07)
